blocking_rules: Quality loss (positive means degradation) is judged against the same approved quality_loss_max; no separate allowed-regression or blanket any-regression rule applies.
Cost acceptance requires an approved net_cost_max and local cost attribution at or below that threshold; null is unresolved, not zero.
Token change is measured but no independent token-improvement target is approved; it does not by itself define acceptance.
A positive cost difference that meets a positive budget is budget_met, not a saving. A zero difference is not a strict saving. A negative local difference is not a whole-application saving claim.
No cost or token saving may be claimed before accepted, and quality or safety failures cannot be offset by cost or token results.
Human approval of thresholds is required before ready/accepted.
execution_status and acceptance_status are the only current state authorities; acceptance_status may be null only while running.
acceptance_status MUST NOT contain pending or aborted; aborted is an execution_status and maps to acceptance_status=failed.
run_completed, if present, is auxiliary and MUST equal execution_status=completed.
A started attempt MUST NOT return not_started, ready, or blocked.

blocked: one or more required pre-run inputs are missing or invalid
observed_failures are preserved but do not change the blocked state
ready: no result exists for the current attempt
running: no terminal acceptance conclusion exists yet
accepted: result evidence is complete, valid, and bound to the current attempt
usage is complete for every included call
failed: execution_status=completed with missing/corrupt/inconsistent result evidence or any applicable condition failing
or execution_status=aborted after a started attempt
safety_escapes > 0 or quality_loss > approved quality_loss_max or net_cost > approved net_cost_max or usage/sample/evidence failure
observed_failures and prior attempt evidence are retained

token_direction.brief_generation_input_cost: brief_generation_input_tokens * input_per_token (recorded; excluded from net_cost in v2)
token_direction.missing_price_behavior: if either price is null, added_output_cost, reduced_input_cost_saving, and net_cost are null
token_direction.net_cost: added_output_cost - reduced_input_cost_saving (local cost attribution difference; excludes brief-generation input cost, retry/fallback calls outside the counted generation call, downstream output changes, non-brief calls, and infrastructure)
token_direction.reduced_downstream_input_tokens: full-report input tokens minus brief input tokens
token_direction.saving_definition: local_cost_saving only when net_cost < 0; budget_met only when net_cost <= approved net_cost_max; whole_application_saving is not claimed

measurement_scope.label: local cost attribution difference, not whole-application net cost
measurement_scope.description: Measures the counted brief-generation output cost and the downstream input-token difference for the five brief consumers only. It is not a whole-application net-cost or saving claim.
included: downstream input-token difference and cost saving
excluded: brief retry or fallback calls outside the counted generation call
measurement_scope.retry_fallback_record: Brief-generation retry and fallback occurrences are recorded even when excluded from the local cost formula; they must not disappear from the evidence.
measurement_scope.expansion_note: Expanding the acceptance scope to full brief-call input/output/retry cost is a pending decision; no full-call net-cost claim is made here.

token_target.note: Token change is measured but no independent token-improvement target is approved; cost acceptance is separate.

claim_definitions.budget_met: net_cost <= approved net_cost_max; does not by itself imply a saving
claim_definitions.local_cost_saving: net_cost < 0 under the local cost attribution formula
claim_definitions.token_reduction: net_tokens < 0; no independent token target is approved
claim_definitions.zero_difference: net_cost = 0; proves no increase under this scope, not a strict saving
claim_definitions.positive_cost_difference_within_budget: net_cost >= 0 and net_cost <= approved net_cost_max; budget_met only
claim_definitions.whole_application_saving: requires independent whole-application evidence; this contract does not claim it
claim_definitions.quality_or_safety_override: quality or safety failure cannot be offset by any cost or token result

post_run_result_evidence: usage completeness for every included call
result_digest may be null only until the attempt completes; completed/failed requires the attempt evidence record
fixed sample size and missing-sample record
abort reason and missing items for aborted/failed

state_priority: not_started/blocked when pre-run inputs are missing or invalid
not_started/ready when pre-run inputs are valid and no result exists for the current attempt
running/null while execution is in progress
completed/accepted when valid result evidence and all applicable conditions pass
completed/failed or aborted/failed for a failed, unevaluable, or stopped attempt
transitions: not_started/blocked -> not_started/ready when all pre-run inputs become valid.
not_started/ready -> running/null when the attempt starts.
running/null -> completed/accepted when execution completes and every applicable condition passes with valid result evidence.
running/null -> completed/failed when execution completes but any condition fails or result evidence is missing/corrupt/inconsistent.
running/null -> aborted/failed when the started attempt is stopped; abort reason, observed_failures, produced evidence, and missing items are retained.
A started attempt MUST NOT return to not_started, blocked, or ready. Input digest mismatch discovered after start ends as aborted/failed or completed/failed.
accepted and failed are terminal for the current attempt. A retry or re-evaluation creates a new attempt and preserves the prior attempt input binding, failures, observed_failures, and evidence.
Only completed/accepted may make budget_met, local_cost_saving, or token_reduction claims under the existing rules.
state_model.observed_failure_policy: observed_failures are recorded whenever observed and are never cleared by blocked, running, accepted, failed, aborted, retry, or configuration repair. A blocked attempt remains blocked if it has not started; a started attempt records failures and ends completed/failed or aborted/failed.
state_model.attempt_policy: Each attempt has attempt_id and fixes its inputs, contract version, prices, thresholds, and input digests at start. A retry or re-evaluation creates a new attempt and preserves the prior attempt input binding, terminal status, observed_failures, and evidence. Later configuration changes do not mutate a terminal attempt. A started attempt never returns to not_started, blocked, or ready; input digest mismatch after start ends aborted/failed or completed/failed. The effective result is the latest valid attempt, while every failed/aborted attempt remains auditable.

measurement_aggregation.target_comparison: total (sum) local cost attribution over all included samples in the fixed case set
measurement_aggregation.token_comparison: total net_tokens is recorded; no token target is approved
measurement_aggregation.note: A per-case mean or any other aggregation requires a new contract version.

usage_accounting.complete: all included calls report usage; token and cost fields are computed
usage_accounting.partial: some included calls report usage; known sums and unknown-call counts are recorded
usage_accounting.unavailable: no included call reports usage; token and cost fields are null, not zero
usage_accounting.no_generation_call: a true zero for the counted generation call, distinct from unavailable usage

usage_policy.required_usage_missing_behavior: complete net_cost/net_tokens are null or explicitly incomplete and cannot be accepted
usage_policy.true_zero_generation_call: G=0 is valid only when no generation call is required; it is distinct from unavailable usage
usage_policy.price_missing_behavior: complete cost fields are null and acceptance is blocked

generation_call_selection.selection_unit: one brief-generation instance actually delivered to the downstream consumer
generation_call_selection.selected_call: final delivered successful candidate for that instance
generation_call_selection.shared_generation: counted once across roles that share the same instance
generation_call_selection.view_updates: each distinct view-update generation instance is recorded separately
generation_call_selection.excluded: failed or replaced candidates and retry/fallback calls outside the selected instance are recorded and excluded from G

downstream_scope.input_difference: sum of the five roles actual final-request input difference
excluded_and_disclosed: retry/fallback calls outside the selected generation

sample_aggregation.target_comparison: total sum of local_net_cost over the fixed included samples
sample_aggregation.missing_sample_behavior: a missing required sample prevents acceptance and cannot be dropped
sample_aggregation.amount_precision: Decimal; unrounded comparison values; display rounding is not used

execution_status.run_completed_relationship: run_completed is legacy/auxiliary only; if present it MUST equal (execution_status == completed). A contradictory combination is invalid and must not create a second independent execution-state authority.

attempt_record.latest_valid_attempt_rule: the latest valid attempt is reported; all failed attempts remain auditable

quality_safety.quality_metric: quality_loss = mean off_score - on_score using the frozen rubric; higher is better; negative means improvement
quality_safety.quality_missing_score: evidence failure; do not shrink the denominator
quality_safety.safety_rule: any real safety escape fails the attempt and cannot be offset by cost or token results

contract_revision_scope: CR-01 execution_status/acceptance_status semantics correction only; optimization target, cost scope, formulas, thresholds, and evidence requirements are unchanged.

acceptance_status_field.null_semantics: null is permitted only while execution_status=running; it is not ready, not accepted, not a pass, and not a benefit claim.

state_table.rule: pre-run inputs, snapshots, prices, approvals, or required material missing/invalid
all pre-run conditions valid and no result exists for the current attempt
acceptance is null while running; observed_failures may be recorded
valid result evidence, all samples, quality/safety/usage/cost conditions pass

state_table.preconditions: any condition fails or evidence missing/corrupt/inconsistent
state_table.rule: completed execution with a failed or unevaluable result
abort reason, observed failures, produced evidence, and missing items are retained
